cues.on: The call list, top of page — twenty clients, ranked
cues.say: This is the first screen a relationship manager sees. Not a dashboard — a ranked list of who to call.

cues.on: Spotlight: the derived summary line (3 briefed / 10 watching / 7 clean)
cues.say: Three conversations worth having this week. Seven clients with nothing to raise — checked, and clean. Every count is derived, never typed.

cues.on: Scrolling the ranked list — one defensible sentence per row
cues.say: Each row carries one sentence that can be defended, ordered by urgency rather than portfolio size.

cues.on: Client brief opens — the navy hero panel, 46px name
cues.say: Abdullah Al-Mansoori. Forty-nine, Balanced Growth, thirty-two point two million. He asked a question in August that still has no answer.

cues.on: Spotlight: the quoted objective and the 42.1% headline figure
cues.say: His objective, on file since two thousand and fourteen: build wealth outside the Gulf, and outside shipping. Forty-two per cent of the portfolio is energy and industrials.

cues.on: The four exposure blocks, separated and labelled
cues.say: On any allocation report these are four separate things — two funds, a stock, a structured product. It looks diversified.

cues.on: THE ORCHESTRATED MOMENT — button pressed, four blocks merge into one
cues.say: Look through the note, and they are one bet. It references two names already held outright.

cues.on: Spotlight: the merged bar — one combined figure, 42.1%
cues.say: Four positions. Forty-two point one per cent. One concentrated bet — read from a single record.

cues.on: The mandate panel scrolls in — the five band markers draw themselves once
cues.say: Now the mandate. Every band, against what the portfolio actually holds.

cues.on: Spotlight: the verdict block — every band respected, no breach
cues.say: Every band is respected. Nothing in this bank's monitoring would raise anything here — and it is still forty-two per cent one bet. That gap is the product.

cues.on: The scenario panel — the question he asked, answered
cues.say: He asked what happens if the Strait reopens. Two and a half million comes off the portfolio, and his charter rates fall the same week.

cues.on: The opening line on the deep navy panel, 33px
cues.say: The opening line, drafted from the findings above. Every figure in it was computed before the sentence was written.

cues.on: The evidence column — file, row identifiers, values
cues.say: Every sentence traces to a row — the file, the identifiers, the values. A finding without evidence is not shown.
